fund.h2: No company and no paid tier: donations pay for test hardware and time on the code.
fund.lede: OpenRig stays free either way; money decides how fast Windows and Linux arrive and how much gear gets captured.
fund.c1.p: Audio interfaces, footswitches and a Windows and a Linux machine to build and test on.
fund.c2.p: Capture packs, licences and studio hours to capture amps instead of guessing.
fund.c3.p: Every funded hour is an hour on OpenRig instead of on something else.
fund.note: No tiers, no paywalled features, no pro version.
dl.h2: Download OpenRig for macOS and plug in your guitar.
dl.lede: One universal .dmg for Apple silicon and Intel Macs on macOS 11 or newer, with no account to create.
dl.soon: Windows and Linux are in the works.
